newsitem.title: USA: Iowa Gov. names ex-state bank supt. to loan board.
newsitem.headline: Iowa Gov. names ex-state bank supt. to loan board.

text.p: Iowa Gov. Terry Branstad named former banking superintendent Richard Buenneke to the Student Loan Liquidity Corp.
Buenneke, a West Des Moines resident, succeeds current board member Robert Grote, Branstad said in announcing 41 new appointments and 102 reappointments to various state boards and commissions.

The appointment, effective Tuesday, needs no confirmation. Branstad also appointed Joyce Hanes of Mason City to the corporation, replacing Barbara Olerich and reappointed R. Barbara Gitenstein of West Des Moines and Mary Steele of Dubuque.
